## ISEN684 Syllabus

Section 195 (12337) Professional Internship Summer 2026 - College Station

## Catalog Description

Professional Internship. Credit 1 or more each semester. On-the-job training under supervision of practicing engineers in settings appropriate to professional objectives. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Approval of committee chair and department head.

## Course Learning Outcomes

Students who complete this course will have an ability to apply Industrial and Systems Engineering in a professional setting.

## Special Course Designation

None

## Textbook and/or Resource Materials

This material Is: No required textbook

No textbook needed.

## Grading Policy

This course is graded S/U based on a final internship report submitted before the end of the semester.

## Late Work Policy

Work submitted by a student as makeup work for an excused absence is not considered late work and is exempt from the late work policy (Student Rule 7).

## Course Schedule

The schedule is set by the employer.
